name: Mixture-of-Experts Neural Fields
definition: A mixture-of-experts approach routing coordinates through a policy network to one of seven expert decoders, each specializing in a spatially distinct subdomain, with a shared encoder.
summary: Mixture-of-Experts Neural Fields partitions volume data into subdomains with specialized decoders, using a shared encoder to ensure boundary continuity and avoid the capacity bottlenecks of single-network models.
